newsitem.title: CANADA: Toronto stocks likely to lose ground at open.
newsitem.headline: Toronto stocks likely to lose ground at open.

text.p: * Toronto's stock market was seen weakening at Friday's opening, with investors likely to take profits after yesterday's tumble in New York. * Eye on weekend.
Toronto stocks will be hit by profit-taking at Friday's open, dragged down by Wall Street's tumble on Thursday and a weaker bonds market.
"It's going to be pretty ugly out there to start with," one trader said.

All the signs point to investor eagerness to sell shares and reap profits after days of gains, traders agreed. The Dow Jones Average lost 71 points by Thursday's close while the Toronto Stock Exchange's 300 Composite Index gained 11.37 points to finish at 6945.07. Canada's 30-year benchmark bond dropped C$0.70 to C$119.09 to yield 6.536 percent.
